Course people and staff permission

Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S21

Inspect course enrollment and grant narrowly scoped, time-limited staff access with auditable revocation.

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Revoke course access
  • Person, role, course, current assignments and effective now
  • Earlier scores, comments and released feedback remain attributed and unchanged
Return without applying changesRevoke this course access
Permissions
  • Instructor alone invites, grants, changes and revokes course staff rights; cannot alter institution accounts.
  • TA sees their own current scope and permitted roster only; no permission editing or allowance basis.
  • No learner or guest may access this workspace.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • TA assigned Q1 for learners A–F cannot open Q2 or learner G through a guessed URL.
  • Expiry during grading blocks further data access/writes and preserves confirmed saves.
  • Revoking one course never affects another course or institutional identity.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
